owner: YEXIO / HOCHTIEF Data Center Partner GmbH (spin-off of HOCHTIEF PPP Solutions) & Palladio Partners
notes: Bavarian StMWI press release 82/2026 (2026-03-02): Spatenstich for YEXIO edge data center in Dorfen (Landkreis Erding); modular timber building ~30x40 m, 12 m high; initially ~2 MW IT, expandable to 4 MW; commissioning planned mid-2027; waste heat feeds Stadtwerke Dorfen district heating (~400 houses per SZ). Land purchase contract signed 2025-06-26 (Stadt Dorfen). Third YEXIO edge DC after Heiligenhaus (2024) and Herne (2026) - part of planned 25-edge-DC network.
